criterion: Determine whether the built-in Agent execute selection is session-only and whether it survives switching to sre.

source.step: Step 4 - default/global override and agent switch
source.observed_outcome: The picker explicitly said the selection applies globally to all default-agent chat sessions. With execute enabled it showed 52 Selected; after switching to sre, execute remained checked and sre showed 23 Selected. The picker also dirtied the open generated-agent editor buffer while the disk file and Git status remained unchanged. No command was submitted because the non-file-mutating precondition failed. Rollback restored the buffer and sre's initial 14 Selected state.

isolation.workspace: local clean checkout and disposable VS Code user-data directory
isolation.network: GitHub sign-in only; no chat prompt submitted
isolation.live_systems_touched: GitHub authentication for the disposable Copilot profile only; no production system

limitations: This is a completed negative observation for a session-only override; no host-side command denial was tested because the picker mutated the active editor buffer.
